Maya_marketing: Quick idea  launching a tiny "Snack Snippets" refapp series: 4 micro-tutorials + one-click deploy. Need launch post, tiny benchmark blurb, 20-25m demo webinar, and inbound lead routing. Target: ship in 8 days.

Priya_devrel: I can own tutorial copy + repo READMEs. Format: one-page README, one-line quickstart, demo GIF, scripts/bench.sh.

Leo_eng: I'll add a brief perf box: p50/p95, tok/s, cost/token, recommended quant. Will include a reproducible bench script.

Alex_growth: Routing: HubSpot form with hidden utm=snack-snippets + select menu for refapp interest. Micro-landing per refapp and CTA "Try hosted" / "Deploy locally". SDR tag = snack-snippets.

Sam_ops: I'll add a CI hook so DeployBot posts preview URLs into #marketing on success and create the Zapier flow: form -> HubSpot -> inbound bucket snack-snippets.

LaunchBot: CI triggered for snack-snippet-1 (ci/7812). Posting preview on success.

Maya_marketing: Assignments: Priya = tutorials + GIFs; Leo = bench + blurb; Alex = landing + tracking; Sam = automations. I'll draft the launch post and social variants by day 2.

Priya_devrel: Tiny request: include this one-liner in each README:
```
redwood deploy snack-snippet-1 --quickstart
```
Keeps it friendly.

Maya_marketing: Timeline check: draft post + landing day 2, repos + benches day 5, QA + launch + webinar signup live day 8. Everyone good?
